posts.name: dpt
posts.cooked:
phantaskippy:

It pains me not to look at my deck, the only time I let myself do that is if I shuffled but didn't draw, then it is fair game because I can shuffle again without breaking deck integrity.

You can always shuffle again without breaking integrity unless you've been doing deck stacking (eg, Visionary, Argent Adept).

Personally, I've taken to keeping my deck in a computer file and drawing from it programmatically.  More portable, less wear on the cards, and more reliable shuffling.
